messages:
ellie (finance): FYI finance just reconciled July marketplace bill and OEM partner total is off by ~35% vs partner invoice. can partnerships check before we issue an adjustment?

jin (oem-partner): sorry about that, we pushed a firmware update that changed the counter name from 'inference_calls' to 'inference_cycles' and switched units to cycles. sample payload below. maybe the connector missed it.

jin (oem-partner): ```json
{"device_id":"edge-77","ts":"2024-07-31T23:45:00+02:00","model":"stream-embed-6b","inference_cycles":4500,"firmware_v":"3.2.1","tenant":"acme"}
```

sam (eng-onboarding): that explains a lot. our marketplace connector mapping only looks for 'inference_calls' and assumes 'calls' map 1:1 to marketplace unit. no cycles->tokens conversion in pipeline.

maya (eng-billing): two problems: 1) cycles are not a standard unit across OEMs (cycles_per_token varies by model/firmware); 2) timestamps in local tz (+02:00) push some events into previous UTC day leading to window misattribution.

anya (partnerships): Jin, do you have a conversion table per firmware/model (cycles -> token-equivalent) and a note on what timezone devices report in? we can add a normalized field if you can include it in future payloads.

jin (oem-partner): we do. attaching quick table below and we'll add a normalized 'tokens_equiv' field in the next firmware patch.

jin (oem-partner): ```
stream-embed-6b@3.2.1: 250 cycles_per_token
stream-embed-6b@3.1.x: 300 cycles_per_token
mini-quant@2.0.x: 120 cycles_per_token
```

ellie (finance): perfect — for remediation we'll need a line-item CSV with corrected token-equivalent totals per invoice period. also need a signed confirmation of the conversion factors for audit.

sam (eng-onboarding): plan: 1) hotfix connector to accept 'inference_cycles' and apply conversion table (config-driven) to produce tokens_equiv; 2) normalize timestamps to UTC and recompute billing window attribution; 3) run backfill for July 25-31 and emit corrected usage events to reconciliation queue; 4) add a validator that rejects payloads without either tokens_equiv OR cycles+firmware/model.

partners-bot: created ticket PART-5489 (oem cycles normalization) assigned to sam (due: 2024-08-02).

maya (eng-billing): implementers: please make the conversion table editable in the partner portal so partnerships can update on partner sign-off without an engineering deploy.

anya (partnerships): Jin — once we have corrected CSV we'll hold credits pending your sign-off. timeline: hotfix within 6 hours, backfill CSV within 18 hours, partner sign-off within 48 hours. ok?

jin (oem-partner): OK. we'll review CSV and confirm conversion factors. we'll also ship firmware next week to include tokens_equiv to avoid future ambiguity. thanks for the quick turnaround. :pray:

ellie (finance): tagging for visibility — if corrected credits exceed $10k escalate to finance director.

sam (eng-onboarding): starting hotfix now, will push small transform and a dry-run backfill to staging. will post results to PART-5489 and upload CSV here when ready.
